_meta.audience: U.S. citizens using ordinary passport books for short tourism visits by air
_meta.disclaimer: Planning guidance only, not an entry guarantee or individualized legal or medical advice. Other citizenships, work, study, residence, emergency passports, dual nationality, transit and land/sea routes require separate checks. Confirm again before departure.
_meta.reviewPolicy: lastReviewed records actual source review, not guaranteed current law. VERIFIED covers only the stated claim and assumptions; PARTIALLY VERIFIED means incomplete coverage or conflicting sources; UNVERIFIED means not established. OUTDATED denotes superseded legacy claims documented in the report. Null source publication dates mean unavailable, not today. Currency and plugs are inherited planning information, not verified entry claims.

destinations.name: United Kingdom

passport.text: Passport must remain valid throughout your stay.

visa.text: Eligible U.S. tourists generally use an ETA rather than a visitor visa for visits up to six months; individual circumstances may require a visa.

eta.text: ETA costs GBP 20. Eligible visitors and landside transit passengers need it; airside transit without crossing border control is exempt. British/Irish citizenship and existing UK permission can change the requirement.

health.text: Route-specific health, vaccination and medication rules have not been fully reviewed. Check official health guidance and seek individual clinical advice.

destinations.notes: ETA approval does not guarantee admission. Longer stays, work and study require separate checks.

destinations.name: Schengen Europe

passport.text: At least three months validity after planned departure from the Schengen Area; confirm all document conditions with the destination authority.

visa.text: U.S. tourists may visit visa-free for up to 90 days in any rolling 180-day period across Schengen countries combined, not per country.

eta.text: Current ETIAS launch and application status could not be confirmed. Check the official EU portal before travel; do not rely on older launch dates or fees.

health.text: Route-specific health, vaccination and medication rules have not been fully reviewed. Check official health guidance and seek individual clinical advice.

destinations.currency: Euro (EUR) for the four countries in this selector; other Schengen currencies vary.
destinations.electricity: Plug types vary by country; check appliance voltage.
destinations.notes: France, Italy, Greece and Spain share this short-stay record. Residence permits, prior stays, border procedures and other document conditions require separate checks. The UK is not part of this shared allowance.

destinations.name: Japan

passport.text: Passport must remain valid for the entire stay, with space for the entry stamp.

visa.text: U.S. tourists qualify for visa-free short stays of up to 90 days, subject to admission conditions. Paid work is not covered.

eta.text: Current electronic registration procedures have not been fully reviewed. Confirm with Japanese authorities rather than assuming authorization is unnecessary.

health.text: State Department lists no required vaccinations. Individual health, medication and route-specific restrictions still need checking.

destinations.notes: Check onward travel and medication permissions separately. Lost or stolen passport reports can affect acceptance.

destinations.name: United Arab Emirates

passport.text: Ordinary passport needs six months validity beyond entry. U.S. emergency passports are not accepted; X sex markers and some prior marker changes can prevent entry or transit.

visa.text: Eligible ordinary U.S. passport holders with M/F markers can receive a visa on arrival for up to 90 days in a 180-day period. Confirm personal eligibility with UAE authorities.

eta.text: Visa-on-arrival eligibility is described in the official source; other authorizations and transit circumstances have not been fully reviewed.

health.text: Route-specific health, vaccination and medication rules have not been fully reviewed. Check official health guidance and seek individual clinical advice.

destinations.notes: Read current advisories. Controlled medications, passport acceptance, work and residence rules can materially affect travel.

destinations.name: Canada

passport.text: A valid U.S. passport book is the appropriate document for air travel. Other modes and non-citizen residents have different document rules.

visa.text: U.S. citizens do not normally require a tourist visa. Most visitors are allowed up to six months, but the officer can set a shorter or longer stay, subject to passport validity and other conditions.

eta.text: U.S. citizens are exempt from Canadian eTA requirements. This does not mean all other travelers need an eTA rather than a visa.

health.text: Route-specific health, vaccination and medication rules have not been fully reviewed. Check official health guidance and seek individual clinical advice.

destinations.notes: No unlimited stay is implied. Criminal history, prior immigration issues, work, study and dual nationality require separate checks.

destinations.name: Mexico

passport.text: Air travelers need a U.S. passport book valid on entry, with a blank page. Check the full itinerary and carrier document conditions.

visa.text: U.S. tourists generally do not need a visa for visits up to 180 days. The officer determines the actual authorized stay; 180 days is not automatic.

eta.text: Air arrivals use digital immigration records (FMMD). Land and sea procedures differ; check the process and permitted stay for your route.

health.text: Route-specific health, vaccination and medication rules have not been fully reviewed. Check official health guidance and seek individual clinical advice.

destinations.notes: Retain authorized-stay information and check regional advisories. This record makes no tourist-area safety guarantee.

destinations.name: Jamaica

passport.text: U.S. passport must be valid at entry and exit.

visa.text: U.S. citizens do not need a tourist visa for stays of 90 days or less, subject to admission conditions.

eta.text: Complete the official electronic C5 immigration/customs form before entering Jamaica. Use the government-linked PICA portal, not an unofficial paid service.

health.text: Yellow fever proof can be required for arrivals from designated risk countries. Exact route, age and transit exceptions require official confirmation.

destinations.notes: Confirm onward travel, funds and personal admission conditions. Read current advisories rather than assuming resort areas are risk-free.

destinations.name: Thailand

passport.text: At least six months validity beyond arrival is required.

visa.text: State Department describes a 60-day tourist exemption for U.S. citizens but warns the period may be reduced. Confirm the current exemption and admitted-until date with Thai authorities.

eta.text: Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) registration is required before arrival. Follow the immigration link in the official source; this is not a visa.

health.text: Yellow fever certification depends on travel from risk countries. Other vaccination advice is individual, not a blanket entry requirement.

destinations.notes: Onward travel, funds, repeat entries and officer discretion matter. Employment and study are outside this tourist summary.

destinations.name: Australia

passport.text: A valid U.S. passport is required. Confirm validity for your full stay, transit route and carrier; detailed document exceptions were not fully reviewed.

visa.text: A visa or ETA is required before travel. Eligible U.S. tourists can use the ETA route; confirm current eligibility and conditions with Home Affairs.

eta.text: Use the official ETA subclass 601 instructions. Current app fees and detailed conditions could not be independently confirmed from the JavaScript-only page.

health.text: State Department lists no required vaccinations; route-specific exceptions and personal health or medication conditions still need checking.

destinations.notes: Authorization is not admission. Confirm biosecurity declarations and any character, health or prior-immigration conditions separately.

destinations.name: New Zealand

passport.text: Passport must be valid at least three months after planned departure from New Zealand.

visa.text: Eligible visa-waiver visitors may travel with an NZeTA and receive a visitor visa on arrival, normally up to three months per visit. Aggregate stay and other conditions apply.

eta.text: Eligible U.S. tourist arrivals need an NZeTA and a completed New Zealand Traveller Declaration (NZTD). Most applicants also pay the NZD 100 International Visitor Levy; check exemptions and NZeTA fees with Immigration New Zealand.

health.text: Route-specific health, vaccination and medication rules have not been fully reviewed. Check official health guidance and seek individual clinical advice.

destinations.notes: Carry onward travel and funds evidence. NZeTA does not guarantee entry. Prior stays, residence and transit need separate checks.

destinations.name: Maldives

passport.text: Official sources conflict: Maldives Immigration lists an MRZ passport with at least one month validity; State Department lists six months beyond arrival. Confirm directly with immigration and your carrier before booking; do not rely on the old one-month-beyond-departure wording.

visa.text: Tourist visa is issued on arrival subject to conditions. State Department describes a no-fee visitor visa for up to 30 days; confirm the duration actually granted.

eta.text: Each arriving traveler, including children, must submit the free IMUGA Traveller Declaration within 96 hours before arrival. Immigration guidance does not require advance tourist-visa approval.

health.text: Yellow fever proof depends on risk-country travel or transit. Official sources differ on detailed child exceptions; obtain health-authority confirmation for your route and age.

destinations.electricity: Type G; verify accommodation and appliance voltage.
destinations.notes: Registered accommodation or approved sponsorship, onward travel and funds are required. Other passport nationalities, including dual-national travel documents, can face additional restrictions. Entry remains an immigration decision.
